note: Answers are checked against the Dragon Ball wiki as crawled. 'expect_min_members' comes from the wiki's own category count, not from what the engine returned, so the eval measures the set rather than today's behaviour. Every question names the series on purpose: that phrasing is what used to hijack enumeration into 'Dragon Ball Z episodes'.

questions.question: All types of non-humans in Dragon Ball
All types of Dragon Balls
questions.note: `Dragon Ball (object)` sits in the same category but is the article about the object itself, not one of its variants.

questions.question: Every Dragon Ball movie
expect_members: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods

questions.question: Every Saiyan transformation
questions.note: The set is Transformations, 160 of them, of which these are Saiyan. A Saiyan transformation is one only Saiyans can reach — not merely one a Saiyan has used. Kaio-ken was invented by King Kai and Krillin knows it, so it is teachable rather than Saiyan; Black Frieza belongs to Frieza and Orange Piccolo to Piccolo.

questions.question: Every Namekian transformation
questions.note: The same reasoning as the Saiyan question, on a different race and with no rule naming either. Great Namekian and Orange Piccolo are Namekian forms; Super Saiyan is not.

questions.question: Every Frieza Race transformation
questions.note: Frieza's forms, and only those. This one also guards the qualifier parser: `race` is a word naming the kind of set, not a constraint, and enforcing it rejected all 160 candidates.

questions.question: Every member of the Galactic Frieza Army
questions.note: The category holds 230 pages: 121 characters, but also the races it conquered, the planets it took, the armour it issues and the battles it fought. Only people are members.

questions.question: Every Fusion
questions.note: Android 1617 is a real EX-Fusion, but only in the Dragon Ball Fusions game, so it is out of scope until the topic asks for game content.
